payload.claim: Per the spec's own 'Notes for the agent' section, three of the four acceptance criteria (2, 3 and 4 - the run_task warning witness, the _default_emit warning witness, and the package()/push_unpackaged_work() warning witness) exercise a 'new spelling' (a property, two flags and a shared function) that does not exist yet, so no mutant find text can be attached to them; the spec says plainly that 'the last three witnesses stand alone, and witness reports skip for each.' Only criterion 1, which edits append's pre-existing try/except body, is positioned for an attachable mutant. This means the core witness gate's usual guarantee - that a wrong build of a criterion is caught because its witness dies under a declared mutant - will not run for three of the four criteria before a person reviews the result; the project is relying instead on the prose wrong_versions enumeration and human review for those three. A person should decide, before a cell starts, whether that reduced coverage is acceptable.
